title: The Day of the Lord

questions.question: Blow a trumpet in Zion; sound an alarm on my what?
questions.explanation: Joel 2:1 (ESV): "Blow a trumpet in Zion; sound an alarm on my holy mountain!"

questions.question: The day of the Lord is coming; it is near, a day of darkness and gloom, a day of clouds and what?
questions.explanation: Joel 2:2 (ESV): "a day of clouds and thick darkness!"

questions.question: Return to the Lord your God, for he is gracious and merciful, slow to anger, and abounding in what?
questions.explanation: Joel 2:13 (ESV): "slow to anger, and abounding in steadfast love;"

questions.question: I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has what?
questions.explanation: Joel 2:25 (ESV): "I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten,"

questions.question: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on whom?
questions.explanation: Joel 2:28 (ESV): "And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh;"

questions.question: Like blackness there is spread upon the mountains a great and powerful people; their like has never been before, nor will be again after them through the years of whom?
questions.explanation: Joel 2:2 (ESV): "nor will be again after them through the years of all generations."

questions.question: Fire devours before them, and behind them a flame burns. The land is like the Garden of Eden before them, but behind them a what?
questions.explanation: Joel 2:3 (ESV): "but behind them a desolate wilderness, and nothing escapes them."

questions.question: Rend your hearts and not your what?
questions.explanation: Joel 2:13 (ESV): "and rend your hearts and not your garments."

questions.question: Who knows whether he will not turn and relent, and leave a what behind him?
questions.explanation: Joel 2:14 (ESV): "Who knows whether he will not turn and relent, and leave a blessing behind him,"

questions.question: Your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, and your young men shall see what?
questions.explanation: Joel 2:28 (ESV): "your old men shall dream dreams, and your young men shall see visions."

questions.question: They leap upon the city, they run upon the walls, they climb up into the houses, they enter through the windows like a what?
questions.explanation: Joel 2:9 (ESV): "they enter through the windows like a thief."

questions.question: Between the vestibule and the altar let the priests, the ministers of the Lord, weep and say, "Spare your people, O Lord, and make not your heritage a..."?
questions.explanation: Joel 2:17 (ESV): "and make not your heritage a reproach, a byword among the nations."

questions.question: Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice, for the Lord has done what?
questions.explanation: Joel 2:21 (ESV): "Fear not, O land; be glad and rejoice, for the Lord has done great things!"

questions.question: I will give portents in the heavens and on the earth, blood and fire and columns of smoke. The sun shall be turned to darkness, and the moon to what?
questions.explanation: Joel 2:31 (ESV): "The sun shall be turned to darkness, and the moon to blood,"

questions.question: And it shall come to pass that everyone who calls on the name of the Lord shall be what?
questions.explanation: Joel 2:32 (ESV): "And it shall come to pass that everyone who calls on the name of the Lord shall be saved;"

key_verse_text: And it shall come to pass afterward, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh; your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, your old men shall dream dreams, and your young men shall see visions.
